postPatchSql: UPDATE chat_scripts SET status='active' WHERE status='draft' AND "packId" IS NULL
releaseNotes:
vmfix30.1 hotfix — VBS launcher Unicode encoding

Real-world report: tenant on English-locale Windows tried to launch TeleHubX after installing vmfix30 and got 'Windows Script Host: Unterminated string constant at line 30' from telehubx-start.vbs. Root cause: VBS files were UTF-8 (no BOM), but Windows Script Host on non-Chinese-locale systems reads .vbs as the system code page (cp1252), which mangles the embedded Chinese strings and breaks parsing.

Fix: all 5 VBS launchers converted to UTF-16 LE with BOM — the WSH-supported Unicode encoding. Works on every Windows locale.

Also re-ships everything from vmfix30 (A1-A7 + Tier 2 patch infra) so this single patch covers vmfix29.1 → vmfix30.1, vmfix29 → vmfix30.1, and vmfix30 → vmfix30.1.

This patch automatically activates any DRAFT chat scripts you created before upgrading.
